zh: 内置组件的视觉收了一遍：数据卡的标题区只留标题与一条有事实的右上信息，12px 以下的等宽全大写标签、编号 kicker 与「7 POINTS」这类计数默认不再出现；字号与间距改读类型、间距令牌，数字统一等宽。状态色收进套件的 --w-tone-* 四个变量，列表与时间线再加一行读屏文字，不再只靠颜色。图表补了峰值、最新值与读屏摘要，表格补了 aria 标签与列作用域，进度条的动画从 width 改成 transform。全息卡加了一层压暗文字区的 scrim，磁吸卡把舞台收回成卡片自己的表面、去掉重复的点阵底，翻转卡背面改成前景与底色对调，浅色与深色下都从令牌来。每个内置组件补了与内容量相称的 defaultBox 与 minBox；题头去掉 kicker，说明改成一句具体的用途。
en: The built-in widgets had a visual pass. Data cards now show a title plus one factual meta line: the sub-12px uppercase mono labels, numbered kickers and counts such as '7 POINTS' are gone by default, type and spacing read from tokens, and numbers share tabular figures. Status colors live in four suite-level --w-tone-* variables, and list and timeline rows carry a screen-reader status line so color is not the only signal. The chart gains peak and latest values plus a spoken summary; the table gains an aria label and column scopes; the progress bar animates transform instead of width. The holographic card gets a text-side scrim, the magnetic card turns its stage back into the card surface and drops the duplicate dot pattern, and the flip card's back swaps foreground and background, both from tokens in either theme. Every built-in widget declares a defaultBox and minBox suited to its content; the board hero loses its kicker and gains a concrete tagline.
